dt_edits.value: Hurl salt at an enemy, dealing non-elemental magic damage with a chance to blind them for %_STATUS_EFFECT_TURN_% turn(s).
[Passive Skill] Grants 1 TP when not moving on your turn.
Deal non-elemental magic damage to all enemies within range. Each enemy hit adds gold to a purse dropped on your square.
Increases damage dealt by Salt Spray.
Increases the success rate of Slumber Stab.
Decreases TP cost of Delegate by 1.
Increases the range of Salt Tax by 1.
The Saintly Seven's Minister of Salt. He holds his ground, profits from standing still, and keeps a ledger no one else may read.
